Foundation instruments

Five analog-inspired instruments alongside the original Hushfield voice. These are recordings of our synthesis models, not vintage hardware.

Open the instrument and choose Foundation → Sound → Instrument. Color, Drift and Bloom shape each sound.

Renders silently. Each comparison uses the same seed, harmony and common gain. Press Play on a clip to listen.
